key_insight: Separately trained neural posterior estimators can be combined at inference time to constrain shared thin-film structure from complementary scattering measurements without joint retraining.
engineering_relevance: This modular approach supports uncertainty-aware thin-film and interface characterization while enabling reuse of pretrained measurement-specific models.
method: Train single-observation posterior estimators using prior-amortized flow matching.
Fuse estimators at inference time through a compositional sampler.
Infer shared structural parameters while retaining measurement-specific parameters.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports single-observation demonstrations for X-ray, time-of-flight neutron and polarized neutron reflectometry, plus co-refinement across neutron contrasts and combined X-ray–neutron measurements.
watch_item: Composition relies on task-matched estimators; the abstract provides no quantitative accuracy or computational-cost benchmarks.
paper_title: Compositional neural networks for multimodal X-ray and neutron scattering inversion
